newsitem.title: LATVIA: LIEPAJA METAL SHARE DEREGISTRATION IN A WEEK.
newsitem.headline: LIEPAJA METAL SHARE DEREGISTRATION IN A WEEK.

text.p: The central depository on Thursday said it had registered the Liepaja Metal factory's share issue of 8.49 million shares.
It added that it would be a week before it can start the deregistration process.

"We cannot start deregistration before the actual figures of the results of Liepajas's public share offer and the stake in employees' hands arrives (from the Privatisation Agency)," Martinsh Rikshis, president of the depostory, told a news conference.
"I expect the information to reach us within a week," he added.
Before the actual trading in Liepaja shares can begin its shares have to be deregistered and transferred to individual accounts.
Liepaja Metal factory, which is currently being privatised, completed the public offer of its shares in February and its controlling stake is held by Agrosin Pte.
Liepaja is the only rolled metal producer in the region.
